## Stage-weighted implicit step: the correction runs with $w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$ under rk3 (`dt_corr`) {#sec-ch07-vic-stage}

### Summary

A stage of @eq-ch07-rk-stage adds $w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathcal L$. The VIC solves a linear system whose diagonal holds
$\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$. Weighting the solved increment by $w_2^{(s)}$ afterwards is not the same as solving with
$w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$, because the operator is not linear in the step. So snapy passes $\Delta t_c = w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$ into
the solve and leaves the explicit tendency at the full step.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Hands the VIC the step $\Delta t_c = w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$ of the current stage, not $\Delta t$; @eq-ch07-vic-stage.

**Data.** Reads the stage weight $w_2^{(s)}$ and the published stage index; writes $\Delta t_c$ [s] for the solve.

**Placement.** Every stage with a VIC, after the explicit increment.

**Activation.** None; it applies when the integrator has three stages (`rk3`).

**Guarantee / limits.** The order is not changed by the weighting; the correction is a linearised backward Euler.

**Evidence.** @tbl-ch07-vic-stage-tests; `test_forcing.release`, `vic_stage_check.py` `[C1]`–`[C5]`.
:::

Local symbols: $\mathsf M$ is the column operator of @eq-ch07-vic-blocks without its $\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$ (the cell
Jacobians $\mathsf J_i$ are its pieces); $\mathcal A(\mathcal Z)$ [-] is the one-step amplification on the decay model, with
$\mathcal Y$, $\mathcal G$, $\mathcal Z=\mathcal G\Delta t$ as in @sec-ch07-rk; $\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i$ [kg m$^{-3}$] is the
total-density part of the explicit increment. The explicit increment $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}$[^rg-4b2178c2b619] and the solved increment
$\boldsymbol\delta$ are in the solved variables of @sec-ch07-vic-assembly.

### Derivation

With $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)} = \Delta t\,\mathcal L$ the explicit increment, in the conserved layout of $\mathbf U$
(first row the dry density $\rho_{\mathrm d}$, then $m_1, m_2, m_3$, $E$ and the species densities $\rho_n$), the solve
works in the solved variables $\mathbf U_{\mathrm{sv}}$ of @sec-ch07-vic-assembly, whose first entry is the total
density. Its right-hand side is the explicit increment in those variables,

$$
\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv},i} = \Big(\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i,\ \Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[m_1]_i,\ \big[\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[m_2]_i,\ \Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[m_3]_i\big],\ \Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[E]_i\Big), \qquad
\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i = \Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[\rho_{\mathrm d}]_i + \sum_{n}\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[\rho_n]_i ,
$$

with the sum over every mass-carrying species row and the bracketed momenta only for $N = 5$; the density entry is on the
total-mass basis. This is how `ForwardSweep` forms its right-hand side, `rhs(0) = DU(IDN) + sum DU(ICY+n)`
({{< code src/implicit/forward_sweep_impl.h ForwardSweep >}}). The solve of @sec-ch07-vic-sweep returns
$\boldsymbol\delta = (\mathsf I + \Delta t_c\mathsf M)^{-1}\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv}}$, and the stage adds $w_2^{(s)}\boldsymbol\delta$.
With $\Delta t_c = w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$,

$$
w_2^{(s)}\,(\mathsf I + w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathsf M)^{-1}\,\Delta t\,\mathcal L = (\mathsf I + w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathsf M)^{-1}\,w_2^{(s)}\Delta t\,\mathcal L ,
$$ {#eq-ch07-vic-stage}

which is one backward-Euler-linearised step of the stage's own length $w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$. The two sides agree
within the $10^{-13}$ relative threshold in the check (`[C1]`). The factors per stage are 1, 1/4, 2/3 for rk3; every other integrator keeps
the full step (`[C2]`).

On a stiff decay $\mathrm d\mathcal Y/\mathrm dt = -\mathcal G \mathcal Y$ handled entirely by the correction
($\mathcal L=-\mathcal G\mathcal Y$, $\mathsf M=\mathcal G$), rk3 damps a mode with $\mathcal Z \to \infty$ to $1/12$ per step with
the weighting and to $1/3$ without it (`[C3]`). Why $1/12$ and $1/3$:

1. The solve returns $\boldsymbol\delta=-(1+\Delta t_c\mathcal G)^{-1}\mathcal Z\,\mathcal Y$, so as $\mathcal Z\to\infty$,
   $w_2^{(s)}\boldsymbol\delta\to-(w_2^{(s)}\Delta t/\Delta t_c)\,\mathcal Y$.
2. Weighted ($\Delta t_c=w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$): $w_2^{(s)}\boldsymbol\delta\to-\mathcal Y$, so a stage gives
   $w_0^{(s)}\mathcal Y^n+(w_1^{(s)}-1)\mathcal Y$. With the rk3 weights,
   $\mathcal Y^{(1)}=0$, $\mathcal Y^{(2)}=\tfrac34\mathcal Y^n$ and
   $\mathcal Y^{(3)}=\tfrac13\mathcal Y^n-\tfrac13\cdot\tfrac34\mathcal Y^n=\tfrac1{12}\mathcal Y^n$.
3. Unweighted ($\Delta t_c=\Delta t$): $w_2^{(s)}\boldsymbol\delta\to-w_2^{(s)}\mathcal Y$, so a stage gives
   $w_0^{(s)}\mathcal Y^n+(w_1^{(s)}-w_2^{(s)})\mathcal Y$. rk3 has $w_1^{(s)}=w_2^{(s)}$, so
   $\mathcal Y^{(3)}=w_0^{(3)}\mathcal Y^n=\tfrac13\mathcal Y^n$.
4. Steps 1 to 3 are exact (`[C5]`). Every integrator keeps $|\mathcal A(\mathcal Z)| \le 1$ on
   $\mathcal Z\in[10^{-3},10^8]$, and the decay converges at first order (`[C4]`).
5. *Round-off.* $\Delta t_c$ is one product of $\Delta t$ and `wght2`; $\tfrac23$ is itself rounded when the weight is
   set, so $\Delta t_c$ is within $2(\epsilon_{\mathrm m}/2)/(1-\epsilon_{\mathrm m})\approx\epsilon_{\mathrm m}$ of $w_2^{(s)}\Delta t$ relative,
   and $\tfrac14$ is exact.

In the code, the weighted step of @eq-ch07-vic-stage is `dt_corr` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}).

`MeshBlockImpl::advance_local` publishes the stage index `rk_stage` before each stage ({{< code src/mesh/meshblock.cpp MeshBlockImpl::advance_local >}}). The hydro forward pass then scales
only the step handed to the correction, by `wght2` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}). If no stage was
published, a direct caller gets a one-time warning and the full step, through `TORCH_WARN_ONCE`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}). The weighted step goes into `_apply_implicit_correction`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}). Inside the solve it sets both the $\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$ diagonal
of @eq-ch07-vic-blocks and the right-hand side $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv}}/\Delta t_c$ of @sec-ch07-vic-sweep. The stage
combination itself is the integrator's, with `wght2` ([`pyharp integrator.cpp:101-122`](https://github.com/chengcli/pyharp/blob/4721715855e937c1e8b218e964c0655f46e56e29/src/integrator/integrator.cpp#L101-L122)).

: Code map of the stage-weighted implicit step. {#tbl-ch07-vic-stage-code}

**How to use it.** There is no key: the weighting follows from `integration/type: rk3` with a VIC
(@sec-ch07-vic-options), and the other types run the correction with the full step. A driver must call
`advance_local`, through `MeshBlock::forward` or `Mesh::forward`, so that the stage index is published; a direct
call of `HydroImpl::forward` gets the warning and the full step. The weighting is these lines
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}):

```cpp
    double dt_corr = dt;
    if (pmb->pintg->stages.size() == 3) {
      if (rk_stage >= 0 && rk_stage < pmb->pintg->stages.size()) {
        dt_corr *= pmb->pintg->stages[rk_stage].wght2();
```

`dt_corr` is $\Delta t_c$ of @eq-ch07-vic-stage, and `stages.size() == 3` is the restriction to `rk3` (`[C2]`). Refused:
nothing; a missing stage index is a warning, "rk_stage was not published before the implicit correction", not an
error.

`test_forcing.release` passes at the pin (@tbl-ch07-ctest-run), including
{{< code tests/test_forcing.cpp forcing.implicit_gravity_work_holds_under_rk3_stage_weighting >}}; the CUDA twin is not
registered in that build. `vic_stage_check.py` ports the stage weighting and the pyharp weights on a scalar
model.[^ch07-vic-stage-run] `[C1]` matches the two sides of @eq-ch07-vic-stage within $10^{-13}$ relative on 100 random
systems; `[C2]` gives the factors 1, 0.25, 0.6667 for rk3 and 1 for every other stage; `[C3]` gives 0.083333 and
0.333333 at $\mathcal Z=10^8$; `[C4]` gives $\max|\mathcal A|=0.9990$ and a fitted order of 1.00; `[C5]` checks steps 1 to 3
exactly. Coverage: a scalar model only; no column run.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Only the three-stage integrator, rk3, is weighted. rk1, rk2 and rk3s4 run the correction with the full step in
every stage; for rk3 that full-step operator has the stiff limit $1/3$ instead of $1/12$ (`[C3]`).
:::

1. **First order.** The correction is a linearised backward Euler; on the decay the rk3 step with it converges at
   first order (`[C4]`). That the same holds for the other integrators is a hypothesis; the check does not test it.
2. **Direct callers.** A caller of `HydroImpl::forward` outside the stage loop gets the full step, with a warning
   only once per process.
